articles.title_en: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
articles.title_cn: 预防性医疗保健利用的文化起源
articles.abstract_en: We examine whether preventive health care uptake varies with cultural background related to patience and risk-taking. We combine individual-level survey data on preventive care use from 27 European countries with country-level preference measures from the Global Preferences Survey. To reduce confounding from institutional and economic correlates of culture, we focus on second-generation immigrants, who were born and currently reside in the same country – and thus face the same health care system and broad economic environment – but differ in inherited cultural background through their parents’ countries of origin. We find that respondents from more patient cultural backgrounds are more likely to use preventive services, while those from more risk-tolerant backgrounds are less likely to do so. These patterns appear across multiple preventive care outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了预防性医疗保健的接受情况是否因与耐心和冒险相关的文化背景而异。我们将27欧洲国家预防性护理使用的个人层面调查数据与全球偏好调查中的国家层面偏好措施相结合。为了减少文化的制度和经济相关性带来的混淆，我们关注第二代移民，他们出生并目前居住在同一个国家，因此面临相同的医疗保健系统和广泛的经济环境，但通过父母的原籍国继承的文化背景有所不同。我们发现，来自更多患者文化背景的受访者更有可能使用预防性服务，而来自风险承受能力更强背景的受访者则不​​太可能这样做。这些模式出现在多种预防保健结果中。

Universalization and the origins of fiscal capacity
articles.title_cn: 财政能力的普遍化和起源
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a model of tax compliance and fiscal capacity grounded in universalization reasoning. Citizens partially internalize the consequences of concealment by imagining a world in which everyone acted similarly, linking their compliance decisions to the perceived effectiveness of public spending. A selfish elite chooses between public goods and private rents, taking compliance as given. In equilibrium, citizens' moral internalization expands the feasible tax base and induces elites to allocate resources toward provision rather than appropriation. When the value of public spending is uncertain, morality enables credible reform: high-value elites can signal their type through provision, prompting citizens to increase compliance and raising fiscal capacity within the same period. The analysis thus identifies a moral channel through which states may escape low-capacity traps even under weak institutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种基于普适性推理的税收合规和财政能力模型。公民通过想象一个每个人行为相似的世界，将他们的合规决策与公共支出的感知有效性联系起来，部分地内化了隐瞒的后果。自私的精英在公共物品和私人租金之间进行选择，将遵守视为既定的。在均衡状态下，公民的道德内化扩大了可行的税基，并促使精英将资源配置为供给而非挪用。当公共支出的价值不确定时，道德可以实现可信的改革：高价值精英可以通过提供来表明自己的类型，促使公民在同一时期内提高合规性并提高财政能力。因此，该分析确定了一种道德渠道，即使在制度薄弱的情况下，国家也可以通过该渠道摆脱低能力陷阱。

Measuring the Sources of Taste-Based Discrimination Using List Experiments
articles.title_cn: 使用列表实验测量基于品味的歧视的来源
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how attitudes among supervisors, co-workers, and customers are related to discrimination against sexual minority individuals in the workplace. Participants from a large, nationally representative online sample in Chile took part in double list experiments  which reduce social desirability bias when eliciting views on sensitive topics  followed by direct questions on attitudes toward sexual minority individuals. The findings reveal a discrepancy between reported and actual levels of comfort with gay individuals in the labor market. The respondents underreported their discomfort by 15-23 percentage points, with the largest bias and lowest comfort levels observed when they were asked about supervising gay employees. These attitudinal patterns were mirrored in incentivized donation behavior: individuals who chose not to donate any amount from a lottery to a local LGBTQ-related nonprofit reported lower comfort levels and exhibited greater misreporting. Finally, the respondents consistently underestimated the broader societal support for gay employees and co-workers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了主管、同事和顾客的态度与工作场所对性少数群体的歧视有何关系。来自智利一个具有全国代表性的大型在线样本的参与者参加了双重列表实验，这些实验在征求对敏感话题的看法时减少了社会期望偏见，然后直接询问对性少数群体的态度。调查结果显示，劳动力市场上同性恋者的舒适度与实际水平之间存在差异。受访者少报了 15-23 个百分点的不适感，当他们被问及如何监督同性恋员工时，他们的偏见最大，舒适度最低。这些态度模式反映在激励性捐赠行为中：选择不向当地 LGBTQ 相关非营利组织捐赠任何彩票金额的个人报告称其舒适度较低，并且表现出更大的误报。最后，受访者始终低估了社会对同性恋员工和同事的更广泛支持。

articles.title_en: The effect of network degree on bargaining: Experimental evidence from the field
articles.title_cn: 网络度对讨价还价的影响：来自现场的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We conduct an artefactual field experiment in real-existing trade networks to analyze how individual network degree affects bargaining demands and outcomes. We combine data from a bilateral bargaining experiment with data of trade networks in 24 villages in Uganda. To identify the effect of individual degree in the village trade network we experimentally vary the disclosure of participants’ identities in a bargaining pair. We derive hypotheses on how degree should affect behavior and find partial support for them. Specifically, we observe that individual degree affects bargaining demands in the predicted direction when one of the bargainers is informed about the network positions but not when both sides are informed. Moreover, network degree affects the likelihood of agreements and earnings, irrespective of the knowledge of the network positions of bargaining partners.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在真实存在的贸易网络中进行了人工现场实验，以分析个体网络程度如何影响讨价还价需求和结果。我们将双边讨价还价实验的数据与乌干达 24 村庄的贸易网络​​数据结合起来。为了确定乡村贸易网络中个人程度的影响，我们通过实验改变了讨价还价中参与者身份的披露。我们得出了关于程度如何影响行为的假设，并找到了对它们的部分支持。具体来说，我们观察到，当讨价还价者的一被告知网络位置时，个体程度会影响预测方向的讨价还价需求，但当双方都被告知时，个体程度不会影响讨价还价需求。此外，无论谈判伙伴是否了解网络地位，网络程度都会影响达成协议和收入的可能性。
